title: HTTPS is transport edge, not Wire UI semantic authority
summary: When composed with Wire UI, HTTPS owns TLS/HTTP framing/admission and WebSocket transport hosting; Wire UI Server owns UI_HELLO, definitions/manifests, snapshots/projections/revisions and semantic session state. Do not merge these authorities because they share a listener.

provenance.claim: HTTPS API/ownership surface; Wire UI composition rule preserved from project integration doctrine.
